name: Wind tunnel view
summary: The wind tunnel in 3D: each car with its surface pressure, streamlines, moving particles and flow slices; pick a model, change the wind speed, compare drag; the flow forms live while the tunnel runs.
help: Wire the Wind tunnel block's Tunnel results into Tunnel and its Live telemetry into Live. Pick a model in the bar (or click a row of the table), colour the car by pressure (Cp) or paint, show streamlines and particles riding them, a centre or horizontal slice of the flow (speed or pressure), and move the Wind slider to see drag force and power at that speed (same Cd). Run tunnel starts a new run with the chosen resolution and wind speed (the Wind tunnel node's id is set in Tunnel node). Drag to orbit, right-drag or shift-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. While a run goes on, the side panel shows the centre-plane flow forming around the car and the running Cd.
